mapper.sql: id, original_name, stored_name, rel_path, file_size, mime_type, sha256, bucket, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cms_kb_file WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT FROM cms_kb_file WHERE sha256 = #{sha256} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_kb_file(original_name, stored_name, rel_path, file_size, mime_type, sha256, bucket, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) VALUES(#{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{relPath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{sha256}, #{bucket}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
